contentContract: Original Q&A content owner is referenced and retained, never overwritten or treated as personally spoken words of Pius X.
Each opening exposes 3 selectable follow-up responses; visitors do not have to listen to all 3 sequentially.
Every newly authored answer exists in English and French in its owning part and links to an inherited exact source locator.
Catechism is approved or prescribed under Pius X, not authenticated personal papal speech.
Cross-chapter links only open a record actually present, or are routed to the independent source-owning module; no invented response to unmapped questions.
Chanoine transition is strictly optional, preserves dialogue trail and passes only source-eligible questions.
Never use historical discipline as a binding current rule; never adjudicate an individual soul, confession, marriage, or priest's guilt.
Presentation owner may choose historically grounded avatar voice after independent voice review; no claim of direct quotation.
